2026 earnings test limits: $24,480 a year ($1 withheld per $2 above it) and $65,160 in the year you reach full retirement age ($1 per $3), raised with inflation in later years. Withheld benefits are not lost: SSA raises your monthly benefit at full retirement age to credit those months, which this estimate leaves out. Income tax is not modeled separately.

Year-by-year: working in retirement vs not working

Each year's spending is covered first by part-time pay and Social Security; savings cover the rest at the start of the year. A negative draw means pay and benefits exceeded spending and the extra was saved.
